sloka: यत् च ते सुकृतो धर्मः तस्य इह फलम् आप्नुहि ।इह सर्वाणि माल्यानि दिव्य गंधानि मैथिलि ॥३-५५-२८॥
transliteration: yat ca te sukṛto dharmaḥ tasya iha phalam āpnuhi ।iha sarvāṇi mālyāni divya gaṁdhāni maithili ॥3-55-28॥

translations.english: O princess from Mithila, put on all garlands of wonderful fragrance and finest of jewels here with me.
